current_focus.summary: Build platform-neutral stock.unpack: Commerce names one packed ticket. No quantity. Restore all packed bags onto the same Not shipped ticket. Packed 3 of 3 restores 3. Packed 1 of 3 restores that 1 beside leftover 2. On-hand and reserved both come back. Available stays the same. Original reserve still matches. Rename live ticket active to not_shipped. Revert-from-Delivered, unpack-some, GUI, live Commerce, Woo, Katana, ship, and deploy wait.

decisions.question: When they unpack a packed ticket, do those bags go back on hold for that same order, or back on the shelf for the next customer?
decisions.rationale: Bobby: they go back on hold for the same order; they would not go back into inventory until the order has been marked cancelled or refunded.

decisions.choice: Inventory Packed is the Shiptheory print trigger. Label printed webhook: Inventory Packed to Delivered, status only, no stock change. Then Katana/Inventory webhooks Woo/Commerce Processing to Completed. Partially delivered deferred. Not this unpack slice.
decisions.deferred_reason: dinkuskit/ship owns the Packed print trigger, label webhook, Packed to Delivered status, and Woo Processing to Completed. Unpack only restores Packed to Not shipped. Counts already locked: Delivered does not move stock.

decisions.question: When does Inventory change Packed to Delivered?
decisions.rationale: Bobby: Inventory marks Packed, that triggers Shiptheory to print. Label webhook Katana PACKED to DELIVERED, then Katana webhooks Woo processing to completed. Partially delivered stays deferred. Iron out on dinkuskit/ship.

decisions.choice: Named unpack-some is allowed later. This first command restores all packed bags on that ticket onto the same Not shipped ticket. Packed 1 of 3 brings back that 1 beside the leftover 2. Packed all 3 brings back 3. Over-unpack waits with unpack-some.

history.choice: All packed bags on that ticket. Unpack restores the packed amount onto the same Not shipped ticket. If they had packed 1 of 3, that 1 comes back. If they packed all 3, all 3 come back. No named unpack-some this slice. Over-unpack does not apply.
